header: scripts/eds-store.ts: lets me look at, or empty, the permanent store of Executive Deep Synthesis briefings (table public.eds_briefing). npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/eds-store.ts list npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/eds-store.ts clear "retention" (removes the briefings whose question contains that text) npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/eds-store.ts clear --all
